source: Pre-school: share of children aged 2 to 4 (24 to 59 months) attending pre-school / early childhood education, as labelled in the NFHS-6 (2023-24) state and India fact sheets, International Institute for Population Sciences (total, urban and rural columns; the NFHS-5 (2019-21) figure is printed beside it). 34 states and UTs ranked; Lakshadweep (small sample) is not ranked and Manipur has no NFHS-6 fact sheet yet. Income: per-capita net state domestic product, current prices, 2023-24, Reserve Bank of India, Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 19 (33 states and UTs with data; Nagaland has no 2024-25 figure).
hook_vo: Odisha's pre-school attendance was over three times Nagaland's at similar income.

facts.sub: Income here means net state domestic product per person, current prices: output booked in the state, not what residents earn. 2022-23: Nagaland 3.2% higher; no 2024-25 figure for Nagaland. {n} states and UTs with data.
facts.vo: One lakh fifty thousand rupees; Nagaland's was two point nine percent higher.
